scope: Read-only source design; no new trainer/config/model changes or execution

priority_checkpoint_gap.finding: Regional and CLS have identical state keys/shapes. Existing strict tensor loading cannot distinguish their representation semantics.
priority_checkpoint_gap.current_exposure: Normal fast16 CLI constructs NativeTripletMIL only. Directly passing RegionalTripletMIL with the legacy config to legacy make/apply helpers can mislabel or consume a CLS-schema checkpoint; this is a static code-path finding, not an executed misuse.
priority_checkpoint_gap.parameter_contract_is_not_a_save_load_ga: run.json parameters includes Regional marker, but checkpoint dictionary and apply helper do not require it.

required_before_any_tensor_copy: Dedicated save rejects any model other than the declared Regional class/representation; verify runtime options against the dedicated config.
Dedicated load/apply rejects legacy schema, missing/unknown representation, wrong descriptor order/grid/count/quantization, or a CLS model even when all tensor shapes match.

Bind the exact representation dictionary and canonical fingerprint in config, run, checkpoint and inference receipt; include regional module and dedicated factory/serializer/CLI SHA in source provenance.

Dedicated Regional schema/identity/source parser; old CLS checkpoint must be rejected before reconstructing model.
Dedicated model-to-checkpoint representation equality gate before load_state_dict; shape compatibility is insufficient.
